description: Seeded customer feature table derived from Day 1 events + orders (RFM + counts + AOV + conversion + favorite category).

seed.note: features are deterministic functions of the Day 1 seed (42); no RNG is used in this generator

fields.recency_days: int, dani od reference do poslednje kupovine (ili aktivnosti za ne-kupce; najhladniji fallback za bez istorije)
fields.monetary: float, ukupna vrednost porudžbina (suma total_price); 0.0 za ne-kupce
fields.aov: float, prosečna vrednost porudžbine (monetary/frequency); 0.0 za ne-kupce
fields.conversion: float 0..1, sesije sa kupovinom / sve sesije; 0.0 ako nema sesija
fields.favorite_category: float ili NaN, modus kategorije po product_view; NaN ako nema pregleda

reproducibility_note: No wall-clock timestamp is recorded here: the generator is byte-for-byte reproducible, so the sidecar must not change between runs. Regenerate with the same seed to reproduce all files.
